decision_summary: QIF v0.6.13 Open Risks CLI is release-ready.
rationale: The change is bounded to structural risk-carrier extraction, keeps semantic risk boundaries explicit, and passed open-risks, trace, validate-all, and npm test verification.
recommendation: Release v0.6.13 and keep semantic prioritization, remediation planning, and hook integration for later slices.
expected_user_reaction: Users can find unresolved risk carriers before release decisions without manually reading every package file.
